annotations.title: Set my availability for a date

description: Set a date on the member's own GigXchange calendar: unavailable, soft_hold (pencilled), or available (clears the manual entry). Same statuses the app's calendar offers; a booked night comes from a real booking, never by hand; only touches manual entries — never booking-derived ones. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch (Settings > Integrations > AI).

date.description: The date, YYYY-MM-DD (today to one year ahead).

status.description: "available" clears the manual entry; the others set it. A booked night comes only from a real booking and cannot be set here.

name: set_my_availability
